comment: Ammunition, the axis a ranged-only game was missing. You hold one type per weapon family at a time, so committing to Hellfire Arrows is a real choice rather than a stat you accumulate. Ammo never runs out -- in a round-based game counting arrows is bookkeeping, not tension -- so what it costs you is the slot and the coins. Effects are only behaviours the engine puts on a projectile. Sprites come from build_terra_ammo.py: arrows are the cut sprite with a recoloured head, bullets and rockets are drawn.

ammo.name: Wooden Arrow
ammo.description: Plain wood. It does the job and costs nothing much.

ammo.name: Frostburn Arrow
ammo.description: Burns cold, and cold burns harder.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.description: Punches through three of them, and poisons what it passes.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.description: Ignores gravity entirely and keeps going.

ammo.name: Hellfire Arrow
ammo.description: Detonates, and leaves the survivors burning.

ammo.name: Holy Arrow
ammo.description: Blessed tips. They hit harder and find the weak spot.

ammo.name: Chlorophyte Arrow
ammo.description: Steers itself. You only have to fire in roughly the right direction.

ammo.name: Luminite Arrow
ammo.description: The last arrow. It pierces, it steers, and it softens what it hits.

ammo.name: Meteor Shot
ammo.description: Ricochets off anything it does not kill.

ammo.name: Crystal Bullet
ammo.description: Shatters into the space around the hit, and the shards bite.

ammo.name: High Velocity Bullet
ammo.description: Halves the lead you have to give a runner.

ammo.name: Chlorophyte Bullet
ammo.description: Turns corners looking for something to hit.

ammo.name: Luminite Bullet
ammo.description: The last round. Bounces, steers, and marks what it hits.

ammo.name: Rocket III
ammo.description: A wider blast for a heavier round.

ammo.name: Mini Nuke
ammo.description: Absurd. Do not fire it at your feet.
